text: 全球科技股“惨遭血洗”！纳指期货跌2%，英特尔美股盘前暴跌23%，现货白银跌破50美元/盎司。 布油触及半年新高，市场严阵以待，中选后海湾局势或将升温。 日本央行维持基准利率在1.25%不变，警告通胀超调风险上升，维持渐进加息立场。 日本央行行长：通胀取得阶段性胜利，暗示年内仍可能加息。 铠侠第二财季营业利润环比飙升57%，资本开支大幅不及预期，第三财季利润指引也低于预期。 63亿美元！币安遭“史上最大”黑客洗劫，暂停全部存储和提取功能，承诺将承担所有损失。 日经225指数收跌2.1%，沪指收跌1.44%，恒指收涨1.46%。
text_en: Global tech stocks were "savagely sold off"! Nasdaq futures fell 2%, Intel plunged 23% in US premarket trading, and spot silver fell below $50/oz. Brent crude hit a six-month high as markets braced for a possible escalation in the Gulf situation after the midterm elections. The Bank of Japan kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 1.25%, warned of rising risks of inflation overshooting, and maintained its stance of gradual rate hikes. BOJ Governor: Inflation has achieved a phased victory, hinting that a rate hike is still possible within the year. Kioxia's second-quarter operating profit surged 57% quarter on quarter, capital expenditure fell far short of expectations, and third-quarter profit guidance was also below expectations. $6.3 billion! Binance hit by the "largest ever" hacker heist, suspends all deposit and withdrawal functions, and promises to bear all losses. The Nikkei 225 closed down 2.1%, the Shanghai Composite closed down 1.44%, and the Hang Seng Index closed up 1.46%.
